paragraphs: The sources provide information on the benefits and limitations of metformin for type 2 diabetes. Metformin is indicated as an adjunct to diet and exercise to improve glycemic control in adults and pediatric patients 10 years of age and older with type 2 diabetes mellitus [openFDA label:FDA-LABEL-metformin-2]. The most common adverse reactions (>5.0%) are diarrhea, nausea/vomiting, flatulence, asthenia, indigestion, abdominal discomfort, and headache [openFDA label:FDA-LABEL-metformin-2].
